About The Company

Plus500 is a global fintech company, listed on The London Stock Exchange and a constituent of the FTSE 250 Index. The company is headquartered in Haifa, Israel, with offices in Tel Aviv, the UK, Cyprus, Australia, Seychelles, Singapore, Bulgaria, Estonia, the United States and Japan.

We focus on technology and most importantly, people. Our people are what makes Plus500 the global leader it is today. We are looking for great team players who are smart, curious, self-driven and who are willing to take risks.

Are you our Plus one?

Milestones

2008

The original Plus500 Group is founded, launching its first PC-based online trading platform.

2009

Plus500 begins its Affiliates Marketing program.

2010
  • Plus500 launches its first web app, providing trading access to Mac, Linux, and smartphone users.
  • Plus500 expands abroad, as subsidiary Plus500UK begins operations in London, England.
2011
  • Plus500 Group launches its first iPhone and iPad application.
  • Plus500 becomes the highest-rated CFD trading app on Apple's App Store.
2012
  • Plus500 Group brings its app to Android smartphones and tablets.
  • Plus500AU subsidiary begins operations in Sydney, Australia.
2013

Plus500 Ltd goes public on the London Stock Exchange.

2014

Plus500 enters the European market as Plus500CY subsidiary begins operations in Limassol, Cyprus.

2015
  • Plus500IL subsidiary begins operations in Tel Aviv, Israel.
  • Plus500 signs a sponsorship deal with Spanish football club AtlÃ©tico de Madrid.
2016
  • Plus500BOS subsidiary begins operations in Sofia, Bulgaria.
  • Plus500 enters the New Zealand market.
2017
  • Plus500SG subsidiary begins operations in Singapore.
  • Plus500 enters the South African market.
  • Customer base reaches 10 million.
2018

Plus500 Ltdâs ordinary shares move to the London Stock Exchangeâs Main Market for Listed Companies, joining the UK FTSE 250 index.

2019
  • Plus500 enhances trading platform with advanced analysis tools, including volume indicators and drawing features.
  • Plus500 adds 100+ new financial instruments, such as the Japan 225 Index and Crypto 10.
  • Plus500 upgrades WebApp interfaces, introducing a popular dark mode.
2020
  • Plus500 signs sponsorship agreements with football clubs BSC Young Boys, Atalanta B.C., and Legia Warsaw.
  • Plus500âs financial technology group defines a new vision for the company./li>
  • Plus500SEY begins operations in Victoria, Seychelles.
2021
  • Plus500 opens a new Research & Development facility in Tel Aviv.
  • Plus500Invest brings share trading to customers.
  • Plus500 completes its first acquisition deal of CTS and Cunningham Commodities and enters the American market.
  • Customer base reaches 20 million.
2022
  • Plus500 expands to the Japanese market.
  • Plus500 launches its new global branding campaign featuring Emmy award-winning actor, Kiefer Sutherland.
  • Plus500 begins Futures Trading operations in the U.S.
  • Plus500 signs sponsorship deal with the Chicago Bulls.
  • Plus500 proudly introduces +Insights, providing customers access to millions of trades, including performance and trends, in real time.
  • Regulatory license obtained in Estonia, establishing Plus500EE subsidiary.
2023
  • Plus500 launches âPlus500 Futuresâ, a new trading platform for retail customers to access the Futures market.
  • Plus500AE subsidiary begins operations in the United Arab Emirates.
  • Plus500BHS subsidiary begins operations in the Bahamas.
  • Plus500 launches Japanese trading platform tailored to the retail forex market.
2024
  • Plus500 secures clearing membership from EUREX, strengthening its derivatives market presence.
  • Plus500 launches âPlus500 COSMOSâ, a new easy-to-use client portal serving B2B customers in the Futures market.
2025
  • Plus500 joins the STOXX Europe 600, a key European equity index.
  • Plus500 obtains new licenses for UAE under SCA, Indonesia under Bappebti and Canada under CIRO, expanding its presence in the Middle East, South Asian, and North American markets.
  • Plus500 obtains clearing membership with ICE Clear US, boosting its US market reach.
  • Plus500 debuts a multi-asset trading platform in Japan, broadening investor reach.
  • Plus500 enters Indian Futures market with acquisition of Mehta Equities.
  • Plus500 becomes the clearing partner for FanDuel Prediction Markets (CME Group event contracts).
  • Plus500 enters an exclusive clearing and technology partnership with Topstep.
  • All-time customer base reaches 30 million.
2026
  • Plus500 adds Prediction Markets to its U.S. trading platform, allowing customers to trade on global event outcomes.
  • All-time customer base reaches 33 million.
